scope: Exploratory follow-up on R16 actual train301 questions/278 event groups/602 fixed responses; R18 same group folds; no original validation/test evaluation
calibration: evaluation fold f; calibration fold(f+1)%5; remaining3 fit; same R18 groups
baseline: Exact R18 float32 mean4 LB784+NLL1 cache; per-fold scaler/weights/LR/threshold/probability must reproduce R18 mean_lr

mmd.aggregation: per-token source mean and source maximum, then mean across raw BPE window
mmd.kernel: original lumina7 top100 unnormalized cosine kernel MMD
mmd.perturbation: replace strictly interior body tokens of one source at a time with equally many frozen independent ordinary donor tokens; preserve question/titles/other sources/answer/prefix length
mmd.donors: deduplicated old R6 actual train visible source pool, frozen before extraction; input-only overlap audit against R16 train; question-text hash + source slot selects token stream independent of labels and conditions

ecs.aggregation: reshape layer28/head28; mean all heads and layers in each fixed band, then BPE window mean
ecs.formula: original attention7 external_context_score with top10pct attended context and final normalized hidden cosine

pks.aggregation: mean layers in same four fixed bands, then BPE window mean
pks.formula: original attention7 standard JSD between FFN-pre/post residual LogitLens distributions

thresholds: calibration-only maxF1, then higher precision then higher threshold; separate window and answer-max cutoffs; same R18
eligibility: same R18 frozen gold/geometry; safe refusals answer negative only; unresolved excluded not zero-filled

secondary_strata.answer_length: raw generated BPE count <=16,17..32,>32; fixed before fitting

limits: R18-informed exploratory reuse, not confirmatory or SOTA evidence
MMD is conditional sensitivity under a fixed answer prefix, not factuality
donor themes and token joining may differ despite identical prefix length
ECS/PKS compression can discard useful head/layer structure
same C does not equalize effective capacity
labels are existing assistant annotations, human_gold=false
fixed-fold bootstrap excludes refitting uncertainty and multiple-comparison correction
